Plot S3 method for Bayesian coverage model

Source: R/3_baye_model.R
plot.cd_bayes_model.Rd

Leverages the bayescoveragemodel package's internal plotting function and applies the custom Countdown (CD) theme and translated labels.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'cd_bayes_model'
plot(
  x,
  region = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  x_title = NULL,
  y_title = NULL,
  legend_title = NULL,
  ...,
  national = NULL,
  legend_labels = NULL,
  options = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An object of class cd_bayes_model returned by generate_bayes_model().

region

(Optional) A region of a sub-national model: its estimates by year are drawn, as a national model's are. NULL compares the regions in one year.

year

(Optional) For a sub-national model. The year the regions are compared in; by default the latest year the facility data has. With a region, the year is marked on its chart.

title

The chart's title.

subtitle

The line under the title.

caption

The note under the chart.

x_title

The title of the horizontal axis.

y_title

The title of the vertical axis.

legend_title

The title of the legend.

...

Chart options by name (see cd_chart_options()): background, fonts, sizes, axes, grid, legend, colours. Other arguments are ignored.

national

(Optional) For a sub-national model. The country's coverage from the facility data, with the same denominator: a data frame with year and value (a proportion), as cache$bayes_national_routine() gives. The comparison draws it as a line and a region's chart as a series.

legend_labels

(Optional) A named list to override the legend's entries, e.g. with translations: model, routine (the facility data) and national.

options

A cd_chart_options() object or a list of chart options: a look made once, to give to several charts. Applied after the text arguments, so a text it holds wins over them.

Value

A ggplot object with the chart options applied. For a national model, or the region of a sub-national model: the estimated coverage by year. For a sub-national model with no region: the regions compared in year, each with its model estimate and interval and its facility-data value.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# `cache` is a dataset with adjusted data; fitting needs the Bayesian model packages
national <- cache$get_bayes_model("national", "penta3")
plot(national)
plot(national, title = "Penta3 coverage, Kenya", y_title = "Coverage")

# a sub-national model: the regions compared, or the trend of one region
regional <- cache$get_bayes_model("adminlevel_1", "penta3")
country <- cache$bayes_national_routine("penta3")
plot(regional, national = country)
plot(regional, year = 2021, national = country)
plot(regional, region = "Nairobi", national = country)
} # }
